data.comment:
# Comfy Bria- Product Holding

Place a product into the hands of the person in a photo with Bria. One person photo plus one to three product shots is enough for a lifestyle image in which the face, pose and background stay untouched and the product is held naturally. Ideal for e-commerce and social content that would otherwise need a shoot. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_bria_product_holding.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.instruction: hold the bag in one hand
